description: Small high-school student's bedroom. Validates the full local generation loop (reference image -> VLM reading -> Agent build program -> Blender -> visual gate) per piece, then a room layout/assembly pass.

room.note: typical small student bedroom; needs a bedroom shell .blend before the layout/assembly pass

objects.brief: Compact student study desk, light wood top with white metal legs, for a high school student's small bedroom
Simple student study chair, white painted frame with a breathable fabric seat and back
Single bed with a simple light-wood frame, a thin mattress and two pillows
Tall narrow open bookshelf, white painted, five evenly spaced shelves
Two-door wardrobe, white painted carcass with two slender vertical handles
Small desk lamp, white cylindrical base, thin arm and a warm translucent shade
